display.purpose: The fresh-session question or active task headline.

body.purpose: Controls, task copy, conversation, and final handoff text.

label.purpose: Uppercase stamps, roles, and compact event metadata.

data.purpose: Repository, provider, model, permission, ID, and status facts.

event-meta.purpose: The smallest source and state labels inside evidence slips.

supporting.purpose: Context explanations, notes, and evidence detail.

detail.purpose: Drawer copy and compact transient detail.

compact-control.purpose: Saved-session titles and other dense navigation controls.

empty-copy.purpose: The larger explanatory sentence shown before the first task.

wordmark.purpose: The product name in the desktop ledger.

wordmark-compact.purpose: The product name in the narrow ledger.

shadows.name: composer-focus
shadows.purpose: Low diffuse lift on the task composer only while it contains focus.

shadows.name: transient-toast
shadows.purpose: Temporary separation for toast messages above the workbench.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Primary easing for lane, drawer, and toast movement.

motion.name: evidence-lane-reveal
motion.purpose: One reveal when real runtime evidence first attaches.

motion.name: working-pulse
motion.purpose: The run-status dot only while work is active.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Session Tab
components.description: The attached orange tab for starting a fresh session.
components.css: .ds-primary-tab { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 14px; color: #fff; background: var(--orange); border: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-tab:hover { background: var(--orange-dark); } .ds-primary-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-dark); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Quiet Resume Action
components.description: A secondary session action that remains visibly subordinate to starting fresh.
components.css: .ds-quiet-action { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--graphite); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-quiet-action:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .45); border-color: var(--rule); } .ds-quiet-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-dark); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-quiet-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Task Composer
components.description: The central task field with an attached primary submit tab.
components.css: .ds-composer { background: #fffdf7; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-radius: 8px 8px 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(29, 35, 33, .07); } .ds-composer-label { display: block; padding: 15px 18px 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-composer-input { width: 100%; min-height: 96px; display: block; resize: none; padding: 12px 18px 18px; color: var(--graphite); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 15px/1.55 var(--font-ui); } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #686d68; opacity: 1; } .ds-composer-footer { min-height: 52px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-send-tab { min-width: 154px; padding: 0 20px; color: #fff; background: var(--orange); border: 0; border-radius: 0 0 1px 0; font: 720 15px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-send-tab:hover { background: var(--orange-dark); } .ds-send-tab:focus-visible, .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Run Status
components.description: A dot, tint, border, and text label that communicate one runtime state without color alone.
components.css: .ds-run-status { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); border: 1px solid var(--green-border); border-radius: 999px; font: 700 11px/1.5 var(--font-data); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-run-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }

components.name: Task Docket
components.description: The dominant clipped sheet that owns the active task and conversation.
components.html:
NEW SESSION

What should Fender do?

One task and its truthful runtime handoff live on this sheet.
components.css: .ds-docket { position: relative; padding: 32px; color: var(--graphite); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% 12px, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 12px)); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-docket::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: 54px; width: 84px; height: 6px; background: var(--orange); } .ds-docket-stamp { margin: 0; color: var(--orange-dark); font: 650 10px/1.5 var(--font-data); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-docket-title { max-width: 22ch; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 46px); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-docket-copy { max-width: 60ch; margin: 24px 0 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Evidence Slip
components.description: A compact attachment for one real observer event, with detail disclosed only when available.
components.html:
Tool activity

Main agent · Emitted
components.css: .ds-evidence-slip { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; padding: 16px; color: var(--graphite); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-radius: 2px 8px 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-evidence-slip::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -1px; top: 14px; width: 4px; height: 24px; background: var(--rule-dark); } .ds-slip-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--stock); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-slip-icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-evidence-slip strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-evidence-slip p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 650 9px/1.5 var(--font-data); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Guardrail Decision
components.description: The paired deny-or-approve decision attached to a real pending hold.
components.css: .ds-approval-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-approval-actions button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-radius: 6px; font: 700 12px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-approval-deny { color: var(--graphite); background: transparent; } .ds-approval-deny:hover { background: var(--stock); } .ds-approval-allow { color: #fff; background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green) !important; } .ds-approval-allow:hover { background: var(--green-dark); } .ds-approval-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Saved Session Item
components.description: A full-width ruled row for explicitly resuming one saved local session.
components.css: .ds-session-item { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 5px 16px; padding: 18px 4px; color: var(--graphite); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-family: var(--font-ui); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-item:hover { background: var(--stock); } .ds-session-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-dark); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-session-item strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-session-item time, .ds-session-item span { color: var(--muted); font: 10px/1.5 var(--font-data); } .ds-session-item time { grid-column: 1; } .ds-session-item span { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Fender's browser visual system treats one coding task as a technical job docket: a calm sheet that gathers instruction, activity, exceptions, and the final runtime handoff. The metaphor supplies hierarchy, clipped geometry, index tabs, stamps, and inspection slips without becoming literal office decoration. It is direct, matte, and operational rather than ornamental.

The browser is the complete visual expression of this system. It begins quietly with one obvious task action, reveals evidence only when the runtime emits it, and preserves deeper facts for inspection. The terminal remains a plain streaming transcript and is not a second visual expression of the docket. No raster texture, external imagery, fabricated logo, or decorative proof asset is part of the system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm technical stock and paper surfaces separated by graphite and neutral rules.
One dominant task sheet, one compact session index, and evidence slips that attach only when real events exist.
Flat matte geometry with clipped corners, restrained tabs, and almost no elevation.
Safety orange for action and attention; verification green only for proven completion.
Authored line symbols and machine labels that make runtime facts scannable without resembling an IDE.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Green means the runtime has actually completed or approved something; orange means action, progress, or a pending decision; amber means blocked or stalled; red means error, denial, cancellation, or disconnection. Text, iconography, and geometry must carry the same meaning so color is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Stock, Not Texture Rule
rules.body: Warmth comes from flat color fields and rules. Do not add paper grain, noise, gradients, glass, or photographic texture.

rules.name: The Human First, Machine Second Rule
rules.body: Use the humanist stack for tasks, decisions, and explanations; reserve mono for short runtime facts. Never set long-form conversation or handoff copy in mono.

rules.name: The Docket Owns the Center Rule
rules.body: Repository context supports the task from the edge, and evidence attaches after activity; neither becomes a competing primary workspace.

rules.name: The Evidence Must Exist Rule
rules.body: Do not reserve space for, count, or label checks, files, tool activity, or completion evidence until the backend has supplied that truth.

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: No soft card shadows, stacked floating panels, blur, or glass. Elevation is an interaction exception, not a resting style.

rules.name: The Not-a-Logo Rule
rules.body: The Fender wordmark is text. Orange slashes, bars, and skewed rules are compositional accents, never a fabricated logo or certificate mark.

dos: Do keep the browser hierarchy task first, supporting context second, and emitted evidence third.
Do use the exact state-color semantics and pair color with text, icon, border, or marker changes.
Do keep sheets matte and separated by 1px rules, clipped geometry, and selective stock tones.
Do preserve visible focus, keyboard submission, Escape behavior, focus trapping, inert off-canvas regions, live-region announcements, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do show resumed provenance and progressively disclose raw reasoning or machine detail.
Do render only repository, session, model, permission, observer, approval, and completion facts supplied by the runtime.
donts: Don't fabricate a logo, paper texture, task count, changed-file count, check result, signature, handoff package, or verification certificate.
Don't reserve an empty evidence column or make activity compete with the central task docket.
Don't turn conversation into chat bubbles, source-editor chrome, a VS Code imitation, or a generic AI sidebar.
Don't use Verification Green for aspiration, decoration, in-progress work, or an unproven claim.
Don't add external images, raster assets, icon libraries, gradients, glass, ambient card shadows, or decorative motion.
Don't apply this visual redesign to the terminal; it remains a plain streaming transcript.
